name: Client Engagement
summary: Organize outcomes, stakeholders, meetings, and decisions.
firstAgentPrompt: Interview the operator about the client outcome, scope, stakeholders, commitments, sensitivities, cadence, and immediate next meeting. Keep customer information minimal and never record secrets. Establish a crisp engagement brief before expanding files.
additionalAgentPrompt: Read BRIEF.md, STAKEHOLDERS.md, MEETINGS.md, DECISIONS.md, and AGENTS.md. Summarize the engagement state without exposing sensitive details and ask which client outcome this pane should advance.
